title: Pointwise generic source etaleness after root normalization
statement: Under the root normalization hypotheses, for fixed D, j, generic η, and normalization point x over j η, there is a source open neighbourhood of x on which the normalization morphism is etale.

proof.text: Apply root-normalization-generic-stalk-flat with H, g=b(f), n=|G|>0 and the actual pulled-back finite etale p. This gives flatness of every normalization stalk above j(eta).

Apply root-normalization-generic-stalk-unramified to the original G-torsor, its compatible cartesian comparison, the invertible group order and the actual root extension. This gives formal unramifiedness at x.

Define the open F on N consisting of points with all normalization stalks above them flat, by finite-flat-target-locus. The first step puts j(eta) in F. Restrict to F and use the stalk criterion for flatness, transporting stalk maps through morphismRestrictStalkMap.

Use formally-unramified-stalk-neighbourhood to choose a source open B through x. Let E=B intersect the inverse image of F. Its map to N factors through the flat target restriction and is formally unramified as a restriction of B. Finiteness over the locally Noetherian base supplies local finite presentation; the flat plus formally-unramified criterion gives Etale (E.ι composed with a.fromNormalization). The equality a.fromNormalization(x)=j(eta) proves x lies in E.

lean.statement:
theorem root_normalization_generic_source_etale_point
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : H)) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    (∀ (Q : Ideal A) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
      letI := hQ
      AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g) ∈ Q →
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)) →
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsRegular D → IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∀ (x : a.normalization), a.fromNormalization x = j η →
        ∃ E : a.normalization.Opens, x ∈ E ∧
          Etale (E.ι ≫ a.fromNormalization)
